notes.title: Build Green, v1.6
notes.notes:
Found the first orc city. Expand it. Create a wretched urban blot on the world, or a tribute to the shining green grandeur of orc civilization.

Also added many more new event cards, including several new card faces.

Fixed issues with inventory, when consuming a single item resulted in consuming 2.

notes.title: Young Ones, Update 1.5
notes.notes: Many events added for child and young orcs.

notes.title: Update 1.45
notes.notes:
Added some events here for non royal orcs under the age of 75.
Plus, some balancing issues have been addressed.

notes.title: INFAMY Update
notes.notes:
There have been numerous re-balances to certain events. This will allow orcs to experience a greater variety of lives on repeated plays.

Added new portraits for Young Orc, Big Orc, Chief Orc and Tyrant Orc.

Added a whole new series of events for those who wish to conquer the world along the INFAMY path. Indulge your tyrannous tendencies!
